name: Chung Hung Steel Corporation
summary: Chung Hung Steel Corporation manufactures, process, and sells steel products in Taiwan. The company provides hot-rolled steel coils, cold-rolled steel coils, steel pipes, and hot-rolled pickled and oiled steel coils; hot and cold rolled galvanized coils; piping/plumbing, structural, line, and casing and tubing pipes; galvanized coils; and JIS, ASTM, and API steel pipes. Its products are used in steel pipes, sports equipment, bicycles, umbrellas, floor plates, C-type steels, scaffold pipes, rigid steel conduit, construction equipment, oil drums, electroplated pipes, home appliances and automobile parts, office furniture, pallet, gardening tubes, display stands, pressure piping and plumbing, g…
